import {createResource} from 'solid-js'
import {usePlugin} from '@conciv/plugin/experimental'
import {Acme} from './rpc.js'

export function AcmeView() {
  const ctx = usePlugin()
  const acme = () => ctx.client.rpc(Acme)
  const held = ctx.client.rpc(Acme)
  const [found] = createResource(() => acme().search({query: 'a'}))
  const {search} = ctx.client.rpc(Acme)
  void held.save({id: 'a'}).then(() => undefined)
  void acme()['items.list']({})
  void ctx.client.rpc(Acme).reset({})
  return <p>{String(found())}{String(search)}</p>
}
